articles.description:
C.H. Robinson CEO: AI will drive freight brokerage consolidation. Read: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE01SE1KRjNMcFFKcmRMR3pPeWNlLXJfcnVReHplTlMxVlVaSUdJY0k1MV9JU1Z2MERDeTJJNE5CeTVJcXFkbF9sWm5RelZaX2FleWhxbzdwRDAzOVBOZkY1QUJBSUJZbVRJNmF1ekc5Y1hsQVBiTEE
Take: it’s not about replacing brokers — it’s about automating the ops layer that keeps margins.
How consolidation happens: AI eats repeatable, high-friction work — instant quotes, carrier matching, ETA updates, BOL parsing, exception triage. That drops marginal cost per load and magnifies scale advantages for firms with clean signals.
What to build if you want to survive: measure ops time per load, log every API/step, automate the 20% of tasks that consume 80% of human minutes. Event-driven agents + PR-driven infra are how I ship operational automations fast. BYOK for cost + compliance control.
Bottom line: consolidation favors data-rich platforms, but vertical specialists with regulated workflows or better carrier trust still win. Question: what single metric in your stack would justify automating a workflow? Name it — that’s where to start.
articles.title: C.H. Robinson CEO says AI will drive freight brokerage consolidation - Yahoo Finance

articles.author: Dhruv Sharma
articles.description:
While building a smart wallet contract for Fishnet — an AI agent transaction security proxy — I ran a self-imposed code review and found a subtle optimization that every Solidity developer should know about.
One variable reorder. 20,000 gas saved per transaction.
Here's the full breakdown.
My state variables looked like this:
address public owner;          // 20 bytes → Slot 0
address public fishnetSigner;  // 20 bytes → Slot 1
mapping(uint256 => bool) public usedNonces; // Slot 2
bool public paused;            // 1 byte  → Slot 3  ← wasting 31 bytes

That bool paused at the bottom? It's only 1 byte, but it was consuming an entire 32-byte storage slot. That's 31 bytes of wasted space — and more importantly, an extra SLOAD/SSTORE on every pause check.
The EVM operates on 32-byte words. Ever…
articles.title: How I Saved 20,000 Gas Per Transaction by Reordering One Line in Solidity

I describe a feature

A Moscow medical clinic was losing money every day. 21% of appointments ended in no-shows — patients who booked but never came. Staff spent hours on manual reminder calls. The booking process was 100% phone-based.
They hired me to fix it. Here's what I built and what happened in the first 5 weeks.
No-shows in medical clinics aren't just annoying — they're expensive. An empty slot that could have been filled is pure revenue loss. At this clinic, 21% no-show rate translated to roughly $7,200/month in lost revenue.
The root causes were straightforward:
Patients forgot appointments (no automated reminders)
Rebooking required a phone call during working hours
Staff had no visibility into who was likely to no-show
Bot: Python 3.12 + aiogram 3 (Telegram)
Backend: FastAPI + PostgreSQL 15 + Redis
